activity.notes: Miroslav Ćiro Blažević led the Croatia national football team from 1994 through 2000, including the Euro 1996 quarter-final and Croatia's third-place finish at the 1998 FIFA World Cup. ATLAS uses Croatia as the represented political community and records the national-team coaching tenure rather than his numerous club appointments.

sources.title: Preminuo Miroslav Ćiro Blažević — Croatian Football Federation
sources.citation_text: The Croatian Football Federation states that Blažević took over the Croatian national team in 1994 and led it through 2000.

sources.title: Blažević, Miroslav Ćiro — Hrvatska enciklopedija
sources.citation_text: The Croatian Encyclopedia records Blažević as Croatia national-team manager from 1994 to 2000 and highlights the 1998 World Cup third place.
